title: Image Host Settings
description: When a third-party image host is enabled, ticket images are uploaded there and shown inline in message bubbles. When disabled, images remain local attachments.
enabledHint: When enabled, images uploaded to tickets are sent to your CloudFlare-ImgBed host. PDFs, archives and other files stay local.
baseUrlHint: CloudFlare-ImgBed site root, for example https://img.example.com. Do not include a query string.
uploadPathHint: The default CloudFlare-ImgBed upload endpoint is /upload.
authCodeHint: The user authCode or an API token with upload permission configured in the image host. Leave blank when authentication is disabled. A saved credential is shown as ******; keep it to preserve the current value.
authCodeConfigured: An auth code is configured. Leave it blank or keep ****** to keep the current value.
channelHint: Leave empty to use the image host default; otherwise uploadChannel is passed through.
folderHint: Optional. Archive uploads into this folder, for example tickets/2026.
maxBytesHint: 1 to 10 MB. The effective limit is also bounded by the server request body limit.
testHint: The test uploads a 1×1 PNG to the image host. Unsaved settings are not persisted.
saveSuccess: Image host settings saved. Subsequent uploads take effect immediately.
loadFailed: Failed to load image host settings
saveFailed: Failed to save image host settings
invalidEnabled: An image host URL is required when enabled.
